description: Execute a staged plan by plan_id, or pass a blueprint directly to build it additively. A plan that changes existing items runs exactly as staged or not at all: it is checked against the server again and refused if anything it would touch has changed since. Building goes in dependency order: roles, then categories, then channels, creating before changing. If a step fails, the run stops and the report says exactly what was created, changed, failed, and never attempted; plan again to finish. Afterwards the server is compared with the blueprint and anything that did not take effect is reported. A build that changes anything returns a change_id that undo_change reverses.

blueprint.description: Build this blueprint directly, skipping the staging step. Only adds; never changes existing items. Refused when the blueprint gives @everyone or an existing role powers in a new channel: stage that with plan_server_build.

id.description: Discord id from export_server_blueprint. Matches this exact item, so a new name renames it.

permissions.description: Extra permissions per role here, beyond who can see and post (private_to, read_only, posting_roles). Example: [{"role": "Event Staff", "allow": ["mention_everyone", "embed_links"]}]. A listed role's extras become exactly these; roles not listed keep theirs.

posting_roles.description: With read_only: role names that may still post and start threads.

private_to.description: Role names that can see this channel; everyone else is denied view. [] leaves only admins. null makes it visible to everyone. Omit to follow the category.

read_only.description: Deny sending for everyone; for rules and announcements.
